nodes.description: UniswapExchange.owner: privileged address used as the sole access-control gate (private address).
Public mapping balanceOf(address => uint) holding token balances, mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom/batchSend.
Public nested mapping allowance(owner => spender => uint) consumed by transferFrom and set by approve.
tradeAddress whitelisted via setTradeAddress; bypasses the sale-condition checks in ensure().
Private mapping _onSaleNum(address => uint) counting how many times an address has sold, incremented per transferFrom.
Private mapping canSale(address => bool) that lets an address skip condition() entirely in ensure().
Private _minSale minimum transfer amount enforced by condition(), set by init().
Private _maxSale maximum transfer amount enforced by condition(), set by init().
Private _saleNum per-address sale-count cap enforced by condition(), set by init().
Public totalSupply minted at construction time and assigned to the deployer.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance lookups and default sender/recipient.
transfer(address,uint) payable: forwards msg.sender to transferFrom and returns true.
transferFrom(address,address,uint) payable: allowance handling, ensure() gate, unchecked balance mutation and _onSaleNum increment.
ensure(address,address,uint) internal view: whitelist bypass for owner/UNI/_UNI/tradeAddress/canSale, otherwise delegates to condition().
approve(address,uint) payable: writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no return-value/zero-address checks.
condition(address,uint) internal view: enforces _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum limits.
delegate(address,bytes) payable: owner-only arbitrary delegatecall execution.
init(uint,uint,uint) owner-only: sets _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale from token amounts.
batchSend(address[],uint) payable owner-only: loop-distributes tokens using unchecked uint total = _value * _tos.length.
setTradeAddress(address) owner-only: sets tradeAddress whitelist entry that bypasses ensure()/condition().
pairFor(address,address,address) internal pure: computes the Uniswap pair address via keccak256.
constructor(string,string,uint) payable: sets metadata, mints supply to msg.sender, sets owner and grants infinite allowance to UNI router.
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate(): arbitrary address/calldata execution in the contract context.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value without SafeMath in transferFrom (arithmetic risk).
Unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath in transferFrom (arithmetic risk).
Parameter _from of transferFrom: debited account.
Parameter _to of transferFrom: credited account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom: transferred amount.
Local _UNI in ensure(): computed pair address used in the whitelist comparison.
Local total in batchSend: _value * _tos.length computed without SafeMath.
Loop index i in batchSend.
Parameter _tos of batchSend: array of recipient addresses.
Parameter _value of batchSend: per-recipient amount.
Parameter a of delegate(): target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate(): calldata executed in the delegatecall.
Parameter _spender of approve().
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress(): new whitelist address.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as _from when transfer() calls transferFrom().
transfer() delegates all state mutation to transferFrom().
msg.sender is compared against _from and used in the allowance[_from][msg.sender] lookup.
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve().
require(msg.sender == owner) is the only guard on delegate().
require(msg.sender == owner) gates init().
require(msg.sender == owner) gates batchSend().
require(msg.sender == owner) gates setTradeAddress().
Deployer msg.sender becomes owner and receives the whole totalSupply.
transferFrom() requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating state.
ensure() falls back to condition() when no whitelist branch matches.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the expected pair address.
pairFor() result flows back into ensure() as the _UNI comparison value.
transferFrom() executes the unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value.
transferFrom() executes the unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value.
balanceOf[_from] is read and then decremented without SafeMath.
Unchecked increment is written back into balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom() reads balanceOf[_from] for the >= _value requirement and rewrites it.
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender], the spender authorization.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] for every sale.
ensure() whitelists any transfer involving the privileged owner address.
ensure() whitelists transfers from tradeAddress, bypassing self._approve and callOptionalReturn logic.
ensure() grants an unconditional bypass when canSale[_from] is set.
condition() reads _saleNum to cap the number of sales per address.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce a minimum transfer amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce a maximum transfer amount.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against the _saleNum cap.
delegate() performs a delegatecall into an arbitrary address, allowing external code to run in this contract's context.
The delegatecall target address comes from the caller-supplied parameter a.
Arbitrary caller-supplied calldata b is executed via delegatecall.
batchSend() reads and writes balanceOf for the sender and every recipient.
_value is multiplied by _tos.length to build the unchecked total.
The caller-supplied _tos array drives the batch transfer loop.
_value is used in unchecked arithmetic and per-recipient balance increments.
batchSend() computes total without SafeMath before the balance check.
Loop index i controls the recipient iteration in batchSend().
_from determines the debited account in transferFrom().
_to determines the credited account in transferFrom().
_value is compared to allowance/balance and then applied with unchecked arithmetic.
_from is the address tested against the owner/tradeAddress/canSale whitelist in ensure().
_value is compared with _minSale/_maxSale inside condition().
Local _UNI is compared with _from inside ensure().
_spender becomes the allowance key written by approve().
addr is assigned to tradeAddress by setTradeAddress().
The caller-supplied addr overwrites the tradeAddress whitelist used by ensure().
The constructor assigns owner, establishing the privileged access-control root.
The constructor sets totalSupply from the constructor-supplied _supply.
The constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the UNI router address.

normalization_plan.reason: Input parameter _from of transferFrom is only meaningful as the debited account of that function.
Input parameter _to of transferFrom is only meaningful as the credited account of that function.
Input parameter _value of transferFrom feeds the unchecked balance arithmetic of that function.
Local _UNI is a temporary whitelist comparison value created and consumed inside ensure().
Local total is the unchecked multiplication result used only inside batchSend().
Loop index i exists only for the iteration inside batchSend().
Recipient array _tos drives the transfer loop of batchSend().
Parameter _value feeds the unchecked total computation and per-recipient credits in batchSend().
Parameter a is the target address of the delegatecall inside delegate().
Parameter b is the calldata executed by the delegatecall inside delegate().
Parameter _spender is only used as the allowance key written by approve().
Parameter addr is only used to overwrite the tradeAddress whitelist in setTradeAddress().
